summary: More ansible.builtin.uri examples: multipart file uploads with body_format form-multipart, reusing login.cookies_string in a Cookie header, triggering a Jenkins build, POSTing from a local or remote file (src, remote_src), Azure headers, waiting until a URL returns 200 with until/retries/delay, and passing TLS ciphers as a list or OpenSSL string.
questions: How do I wait until a URL is reachable in Ansible?
How do I upload a file with the uri module?
How do I reuse a cookie between uri tasks?
How do I set TLS ciphers in the uri module?

answer_card.title: Wait until a URL answers 200
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://192.0.2.1/some/test"
    follow_redirects: none
    method: GET
  register: _result
  until: _result.status == 200
  retries: 720   # 720 * 5 s = 1 hour
  delay: 5
```
